events.name: DEF CON 34 (2026)
events.description: Join us at the world's largest hacker convention where Red Team Village will host workshops, capture the flag competitions, more!

sponsors.name: OffSec
sponsors.description: OffSec is a global leader in cybersecurity workforce development, empowering individuals and organizations to outsmart cyber threats. Creator of Kali Linux, the ExploitDB vulnerability database, and the OSCP and OSCE certifications, OffSec delivers hands-on, practical training through live labs and enterprise cyber ranges. For over 15 years, OffSec has built the industry-standard in offensive security education, helping security professionals think like adversaries and defend like champions.

sponsors.name: Amazon
sponsors.description: The Devices and Services Security team builds innovative tools that detect, assess, and mitigate security issues across our consumer device businesses, from Echo to Fire TV to Alexa. We believe the best way to protect our customers is to ensure our products are secure and compliant by default, and our security engineers and developers are working together across the product development life cycle to make that a reality.

sponsors.name: Corelight
sponsors.description: Corelight transforms network and cloud activity into evidence so that data-first defenders can stay ahead of ever-changing attacks. Delivered by our Open NDR Platform, Corelight’s comprehensive, correlated evidence gives you unparalleled visibility into your network. This evidence allows you to unlock new analytics, investigate faster, hunt like an expert, and even disrupt future attacks. Our on-prem and cloud sensors go anywhere to capture structured, industry-standard telemetry and insights that work with the tools and processes you already use. Corelight’s global customers include Fortune 500 companies, major government agencies, and research universities.

sponsors.name: Flare
sponsors.description: Flare is the platform that hundreds of organizations around the globe select to end the risk of account takeover, ransomware attacks and data breaches caused by human and non-human identity compromise. As the leader in identity-first Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), Flare helps detect high-risk identity exposures with the largest collection of stealer logs, criminal forums, and identity exposures in the industry. For more information, visit the website or start a free trial to experience the platform firsthand. Join our Discord community and explore Flare Academy to stay up-to-date on the latest in threat intelligence.

sponsors.name: Tenzai
sponsors.description: Tenzai is an AI-native cybersecurity company building autonomous AI hackers to ensure enterprises deliver unbreakable code. Its platform actively hacks, exploits, and helps fix vulnerabilities across enterprise software - continuously and at scale. Founded in 2025 by cybersecurity veterans Pavel Gurvich, Ariel Zeitlin, Ofri Ziv, Itamar Tal, and Aner Mazur, Tenzai has raised $75 million in seed funding from leading investors including Battery Ventures, Greylock Partners, Lux Capital, and Swish Ventures.

sponsors.name: Simaptic
sponsors.description: Built by veteran operators and proudly backed by BC Security, SIMAPTIC provides realistic, continuous threat validation across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments. Our system safely emulates end-to-end attacker behavior to uncover critical infrastructure vulnerabilities. Ultimately, we turn complex adversarial campaigns into clear, actionable reports that both your SOC and executive teams can actually use.

sponsors.name: SpecterOps
sponsors.description: SpecterOps is the creator of BloodHound and a pioneer in Identity Attack Path Management. Drawing on deep expertise in adversary tradecraft, SpecterOps helps organizations identify and eliminate the attack paths that put their most critical assets at risk. BloodHound, the company’s foundational open-source platform, is widely used by defenders and red teams to understand how identity and access can be abused in complex environments. BloodHound Enterprise extends that practice for security teams with capabilities for attack path prioritization, remediation guidance, and reporting to reduce identity risk at scale.

sponsors.name: Bishop Fox
sponsors.description: Bishop Fox is the leading authority in offensive security, providing solutions ranging from continuous penetration testing, red teaming, and attack surface management to product, cloud, and application security assessments. Discover why our Cosmos platform, service innovation, and culture of excellence draw industry awards, and our offerings are consistently ranked as “world class” by customers.

sponsors.name: CYQUEST
sponsors.description: CYQUEST is a gamified cybersecurity learning platform where students master real-world skills through quests, challenges, and leveling up. Gaming meets hacking education - gain XP with every win. Complete quests, earn XP, unlock achievements. Sign up today for free!

sponsors.name: Maltek Solutions
sponsors.description: At Maltek Solutions, we are driven by an unwavering passion for cybersecurity. Our mission is to provide the best possible security solutions tailored to each customers unique needs. We believe in transparency, fairness, and equitable treatment for our team, which fosters an environment that enhances our ability to deliver top-notch services. By collaborating closely with our customers at every step, we ensure solutions that not only meet their security requirements but also align with their budget constraints. Our holistic approach, engaging both executive decision-makers and frontline security teams, allows us to understand and address the diverse aspects of our customers’ security posture

sponsors.name: Skillbit
sponsors.description: SkillBit Labs is a continuous learning platform designed to help assess and develop cybersecurity skills through hands-on, bite-sized labs. Whether you're an individual getting started in cybersecurity or an enterprise security manager, SkillBit has the resources for you to help take you / your team to the next level.

sponsors.name: Zero-Point Security
sponsors.description: Zero-Point Security is a specialized cybersecurity training firm based in Warrington, UK. Zero‑Point Security is widely recognized for its red team operations training, delivering high-demand, self-paced courses to individuals and businesses seeking advanced offensive operations skills. Well-known courses include Red Team Operations I and II, both which are certified by the Council of Registered Ethical Security Testers (CREST).

sponsors.name: Altered Security
sponsors.description: Start your Red Team training journey Altered Security! Altered Security offers multiple on-prem Red Team and Azure Red Team courses with affordable and enterprise-like hands-on labs. We are the creators of the popular Red Team certifications - CRTP, CRTE and CARTP. Join more than 40K professionals from 130+ countries.

sponsors.name: Arcanum Security
sponsors.description: Arcanum Information Security provides top-tier security assessments and training. We offer a full range of pentest and red team assessments, as well as comprehensive AI Pentests. Additionally, we train on cutting-edge web assessment techniques, AI Red Teaming and Pentesting, and AI Scaling for security teams.

sponsors.name: Packt
sponsors.description: Packt is a global, trusted tech publisher empowering developers, security professionals, and engineers with hands-on learning across today's most vital domains — from cybersecurity and AI to DevOps, data, cloud, and more. With a library of over 9,000 titles, Packt delivers practical, real-world guidance to help individuals and teams build skills that matter. At DEF CON, we're proud to support the Red Team Village with a curated collection of books focused on supply chain cybersecurity, offensive security, AI in cybersecurity, and so. Whether you're a red teamer, ethical hacker, or security engineer, Packt's resources are designed to sharpen your skills with tools and techniques that reflect real-world challenges and scenarios.

sponsors.name: PentestingExams.com
sponsors.description: PentestingExams by The SecOps Group provides hands-on, practical cybersecurity certifications focused on real-world penetration testing, application security, cloud security, AI/LLM security, and red teaming skills.

sponsors.name: White Knight Labs
sponsors.description: A Global Cyber Security Consultancy specializing in Offensive Cyber Engagements.
